name: mission-control
description: Coordinate several Claude Code sessions on one repository: a ledger of shared-resource slots enforced by hooks, a /mc board pane, tools that report, request, grant and broadcast, a kick-off that writes each session's brief, and the protocol that came out of running it.

enabled.title: Mission control on
enabled.description: The one switch for all of it. Off, nothing is registered and the command hooks still run but the pane, the tools and the slot approval do not.

approve_in_slot.title: Approve gated commands under a held slot
approve_in_slot.description: While this session holds a resource's slot and runs the command from its own worktree, a project hook's ask on that command is answered allow, so the person does not type it. Only resources marked approve_in_slot in the project config; never a human gate.

refresh_seconds.title: Board refresh
refresh_seconds.description: How often the board rereads the ledger while open, in seconds.
